title: Dutch van der Linde's Blackwater secret in Red Dead 2
subject: dutch
description:
Did Dutch really have no choice in Blackwater? 👇

The ferry job in Blackwater that started everything in Red Dead Redemption 2. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2.

scenes.text: The ferry job in Blackwater was supposed to be easy.
In 1899, the gang went after a ferry carrying a fortune in cash.
On board, something went wrong. Dutch shot a young woman named Heidi McCourt.
Lawmen flooded the docks. Jenny Kirk and Davey Callander didn't survive the escape, and the money stayed hidden in town.
Dutch never gave a straight answer about that night, not even to Arthur.
Pinkerton agent Andrew Milton started hunting the gang because of it.
Everything that broke the Van der Linde gang began on that ferry.
